description: Localytics-style mobile marketing customer behavioral features with churn label. Designed for supervised churn modeling, SHAP explainability, and subgroup bias checks.

values.1: churned (no meaningful activity in observation window)

features.frequency_30d: App sessions in the last 30 days (frequency)
features.frequency_90d: App sessions in the last 90 days (frequency)
features.in_app_events_30d: Tracked in-app events in last 30 days (engagement)
features.campaign_clicks_30d: Campaign / deep-link clicks in last 30 days (engagement)
features.purchases_90d: In-app purchase transactions in last 90 days
features.acquisition_channel: Acquisition proxy: organic | paid_social | referral | app_store | paid_search

datasets.customers_churn_cold_start.json: Newly acquired users, tenure <= 21 days (200 rows)

notes: Behavioral features are correlated with churn (high recency, low frequency/engagement -> higher churn).
Mild subgroup base-rate differences exist for bias exercises (age_band 55+, paid_social, android+emerging markets).
Class imbalance is intentional; prefer PR-AUC / recall@k / precision-recall over raw accuracy.
